findings.message: Part (ii) has the wrong quantifier on γ. The cited problem asks whether completeness holds for every γ with 1 < γ < 2, whereas the formal statement requires only one γ in that interval that works uniformly for all admissible α and β. Thus the Lean statement is strictly weaker than the cited problem. The evidence records the exact declaration and confirms that it builds, so this is a semantic mismatch rather than an elaboration failure. The docstring likewise leaves γ unquantified.
findings.suggestion: Replace `∃ γ ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2` with `∀ γ ∈ Set.Ioo (1 : ℝ) 2`, and update the theorem docstring to say explicitly that the question concerns every `1 < γ < 2`.
